title: Cyberpunk Universal Hands VR
creator: natpoh10
licence: Creator-controlled package with restrictive Nexus redistribution and modification terms; described by the creator as free and open-source, but no independently pinned permissive repository licence is established in this record
rights_boundary: Store metadata, interface patterns and derived engineering notes only until an exact public source repository and licence are pinned. Do not mirror, modify or redistribute the package.
evidence_role: Operational and interface evidence for transport-neutral hand tracking through bounded shared memory, full-arm IK, calibration, persistent offsets and head-relative pose handling.
known_boundaries: The source consumes tracking from BodyWalkVR, OpenXR, SteamVR or custom producers through a shared-memory contract.
The package depends on RED4ext, Cyber Engine Tweaks and Mod Settings.
The advertised open-source status is not treated as a reusable licence until the exact repository and licence file are pinned.
No Quest 3 Air Link acceptance has been performed by Stephanos.
promotion_rule: Promote the shared-memory pose contract and calibration concepts as derived methods only. Require exact source, licence and local runtime proof before code reuse or acceptance.
